title: Your Business
subtitle: What you offer, your prices, and your business facts in one place — what Jawab relies on when it answers your customers.

readiness.title: What can Jawab answer about?
readiness.hint: Jawab answers instantly from what it knows. What's missing, your customers ask about and get nothing — tap to complete it.

lists.title: Business lists

lists.nameCharsLeft: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
